name: Ruou doac
summary: Rượu đoác is the Chứt drink made from the sap of the đoác palm, Arenga pinnata. Starch from the same palm fed families in hard times.
origin: Chứt villages in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: With cơm pồi and ốc lèn, it is one of the foods tied to Chứt daily life, custom, and festivals.
howToEat: It is a drink of đoác palm sap. The palm starch is a separate food, not the drink.
seoDescription: Rượu đoác is the Chứt drink made from đoác palm sap in the villages around Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
